text: I can't see your specific limit, but you can check it in the Albert app by going to the home screen and tapping "Instant" (or "Advances and loans," depending on your app version). Limits range from $25 to $1,000 and are based on factors like your account activity and transaction history. Few members qualify for the full $1,000, and your limit can change over time. Boost may also increase your limit if you meet its qualification criteria.
